scenario: valid calls with date_range object on both charts (prior PARTIAL call used non-existent limit/offset params, which the real schema rejects). Also tested chart_id alone (no date_range) on zero chart to check whether date_range is truly optional per the MCP schema.

result_summary.trim_report: anchors trimmed 27->13 to fit 40kb budget, with recover_via hint to narrow date_range

minor_finding: The MCP tool's own JSON-schema does not list date_range in `required` (only chart_id is required), but the underlying Python sidecar (/api/compute/phala/event_anchors) treats date_range as a mandatory body field and 422s without it. This is a schema/implementation mismatch — not silently wrong data (the 422 is an honest, typed rejection), so it does not rise to a GAP, but the MCP-exposed schema is misleading about which args are truly optional.
